governed_construct: A JSX element that renders an image: either an intrinsic element, or a component element (any name) whose tag identifier is bound to an imported image component (the default export of 'next/image' or an image component from another library).
interpretation: The rule asks that images be rendered through Next.js's optimized Image component. Each JSX image element in a file is one instance. An instance conforms if its tag identifier resolves to the default import of the module 'next/image', under any local name (Image, NextImage, Img). An instance violates if it is an intrinsic element (including one inside ), or a component whose binding resolves to a different image component (e.g. react-bootstrap/Image, antd's Image), even when it is named Image. A file with no image-rendering JSX elements is NOT_APPLICABLE. The tag name alone is insufficient: 'Image' may be bound to a non-Next library and next/image may be aliased, so deciding conformance requires resolving the binding of the tag identifier to its import declaration.
